body:
Quick mode — no voting panel. Rounds 1-3: 5 Cursor specialists in parallel + generic Codex. Main agent reviewed findings across 1 round.

Round 1 findings (4 Cursor specialists OK, 1 failed, Codex OK):
- Accepted: 4 (jq gate removal, dead derive_category, json-object slurp sanitizer, run-analysis per-run isolation, timing-report unavailable JSON + js() C0 fix)
- Rejected: nit/latent findings (external NDJSON miners, no offline JSON test, model_roster provenance by design, --issue legacy no-op)

Round stopped after round 1 (non-substantial: < 2 high-severity bugs, < 100 LOC, < 8 findings).
